name: Southern Oregon Chirporactic-Main St
address: Kristen Williams, 410 N Main St, Ashland, OR 97520

nadir.desc: The property consists of a multi-section commercial building with flat roofs on a corner lot at N Main St|Solar panels cover a large portion of an adjacent building's larger flat roof|Paved parking lots with marked spaces sit on the Main St side and on the curved-street side|Mature trees and landscaping line the Main St frontage and the lot edges|Sidewalks, crosswalks, and a bike lane run along both public roads|A neighboring building with a metal roof sits beside the lot, separated by a row of tall narrow trees.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces N Main St and the curved side street|A sidewalk, street trees, and a paved parking lot sit between the road and the building|The street elevation includes a rounded entry|Flat roof sections and solar panels are visible on the adjacent roof|Crosswalks and a bike lane run along the curved public road|The neighboring metal-roof building is visible beyond the lot.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows a paved parking lot, a row of tall narrow trees along the lot line, and the neighboring buildings|A public road and crosswalk sit beyond the parking lot|Landscaping occupies the edges of the lot.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows a few windows at the back of the building and an additional building with solar panels, a paved parking lot with marked spaces, and the neighboring metal-roof building|Street trees and landscaping border the lot|Public roads with crosswalks run along the outer edges of the site|A fence line is visible between this parking area and the neighboring lot.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the street-facing wall, the rounded entry, and a paved parking lot with marked spaces|Solar panels sit on the flat roof of the adjacent building|Sidewalks, crosswalks, and a bike lane run along the curved public road|The row of tall narrow trees and the neighboring metal-roof building are visible beyond the lot.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from N Main St and the curved side street into paved parking lots on more than one side of the building. The site is a corner commercial building in a mixed residential and commercial area. Crosswalks and sidewalks run along both street frontages. Mature trees along the Main St frontage may limit some sightlines from the road. No gates are visible from the imagery. The neighboring metal-roof building shares the block and is separated by trees and a fence line.
